title: [Boost1.62.0] PDBs are not built in Release [was: could not find matching pdb]

labels.name: category:port-bug
labels.description: The issue is with a library, which is something the port should already support

body:
```
> vcpkg install boost
.
.
.
-- Packaging x86-windows-dbg done
-- Warning: Could not find a matching pdb file for:
    D:/vcpkg/packages/boost_x86-windows/bin/boost_atomic-vc140-mt-1_62.dll
.
.
.
```

(full install log : http://pastebin.com/fY66Bqwa)

I think we should also copy `.pdb` files. 

https://github.com/Microsoft/vcpkg/blob/ae8f6e3271989b6c0fe8c1dbe1e2e486c2a504bf/ports/boost/portfile.cmake#L98

In `prifile.cmake`, `vcpkg_copy_pdbs()` was called but doesn't work.
